definitions.explanation: Being appointed to a position for a second or subsequent time after having previously held and left it. Used for political leaders, corporate executives, and organizational officers.

examples.japanese: ⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{再就任|さいしゅうにん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ことになった。
examples.english: The company president will be reappointed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{前|ぜん}→前〜：03957_zen⟧CEO ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{再就任|さいしゅうにん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}める→求める：02316_motomeru⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}まっている→高まる：02066_takamaru⟧。
examples.english: Calls for the reappointment of the former CEO are growing louder.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一度|いちど}→一度：01312_ichido⟧⟦{辞任|じにん}→辞任：10144_jinin⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{組織|そしき}→組織：03320_soshiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{立|た}て{直|なお}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{再就任|さいしゅうにん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{受|う}けた→引き受ける：03140_hikiukeru⟧。
examples.english: He resigned once but accepted reappointment in order to rebuild the organization.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{再|さい}→再〜：03953_sai⟧ (again/re-) and ⟦{就任|しゅうにん}→就任：12368_shuunin⟧ (assuming office). Describes the act of taking up a position that one previously held. The prefix ⟦{再|さい}→再〜：03953_sai⟧ productively attaches to many action nouns to add the meaning of "again."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {再就任|さいしゅうにん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be reappointed
- {再就任|さいしゅうにん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{果|は}たす→果たす：10060_hatasu⟧: to achieve reappointment
- {再就任|さいしゅうにん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{要請|ようせい}→要請：05463_yousei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to request reappointment

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{再任|さいにん}→再任：17443_sainin⟧: reappointment — a shorter synonym, often used in official contexts
- ⟦{就任|しゅうにん}→就任：12368_shuunin⟧: assumption of office — the base word, first appointment
- ⟦{復帰|ふっき}→復帰：12564_fukki⟧: return — broader, can apply to returning to any role or activity
- ⟦{辞任|じにん}→辞任：10144_jinin⟧: resignation — the act of leaving a position
